verdict.rationale: Square explicitly markets ML-based fraud blocking and lets sellers 'set custom rules and alerts to manage risk' (square-docs-28, square-docs-29), which covers the core ask, but there's no documentation of an actual rules-builder UI/API, fraud score access, or a review/allow/block workflow with granularity, nor any independent corroboration of how the custom rules work. missing for 10: developer/API-level access to fraud scores, documented rule configuration (block/review/allow) mechanics, and independent/hands-on validation of the rules engine.
